title: 110쪽 · 3x CO Open —+ BTN 3-Bet —» BB 4-Bet (1/2-pot)
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: The only difference here is that the button will be getting a better price to continue in position. That's fine because 4-betting is still much better than flatting. Just be prepared to go post-flop.
